dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "...Following Incident T-████, operation of the Kuuvahki Barrier Activation Terminal now requires the presence of no fewer than two certified safety officers, irrespective of operator rank..."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "...Whether it's a Landcruiser or a soldier's ██, all are valuable assets of Her Majesty. Non-standard operations have already led to the permanent loss of at least █ Landcruisers and █ soldiers..."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "...Test Operator D.A.████ has been placed on indefinite leave pending a disciplinary hearing for gross negligence. Extreme caution is once again stressed to all..."
